Kimberly — thanks for the walkthrough last week. A couple of follow-ups from our resilience team before we finalize the RFP responses:

1) Can you confirm your measurable RTO and RPO for the Redwood Private deployment when configured in an active/passive cross-AZ topology? We need numbers that we can include in our FFIEC mapping.
2) For DR runbooks: do you provide a read-only runbook for customer auditors, or do auditors access via a controlled jumpbox only? What authentication and audit trails are recorded for runbook access?
3) Evidence of restore tests: what cadence do you run full restores from backup, and do you have a test matrix showing durations and success rates for the past 12 months?
4) KMS/key rotation: are customer-managed keys supported and what is your standard key rotation window?

Appreciate concise answers and any artifacts (summary PDF + test matrix).

Tom

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Tom — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (Product Compliance) and Rishi (Resilience/Infra) to validate numbers and attach the artifacts. High-level answers below; we will attach a short runbook summary and a restore-test matrix in a follow-up message.

- RTO (active/passive, cross-AZ): typical targeted recovery time for control-plane failover is 30 minutes for a single-region failover path; for full service recovery in a cross-region DR run we document an RTO of up to 4 hours depending on dataset size and warmup of model caches.
- RPO: we target near-zero user-facing RPO for active workloads using synchronous metadata checkpoints + asynchronous object-store snapshots; practical RPO for customer data in Private deployments is <= 15 minutes when backup cadence is configured to 15-minute snapshots.
- Runbook/auditor access: we provide a read-only runbook summary PDF for auditors by default; for deeper operational playbooks auditors can request temporary jumpbox access scoped to a time window (MFA + short-lived SSO) with session recording. All access is logged to our audit logs and retained per customer retention settings.
- Restore cadence: we run automated incremental restores as part of quarterly full-restore validation and weekly partial restores for critical subsystems (KV cache rehydration simulation). We will attach the last 12 months' test matrix.
- KMS: support for customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS) with optional HSM-backed keys. Recommended rotation window 90 days; support for custom rotation schedules via customer-supplied lifecycle policies.

Will send the evidence package in the next message. If you need different RTO/RPO language for your FFIEC mapping, tell us the specific control IDs you plan to map to and we can adjust the phrasing.

—Kimberly
Director, Enterprise Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

1) Measured RTO / RPO
- RTO: 30 minutes for control-plane failover within-region (active/passive AZ), and up to 4 hours for full cross-region recovery where large model caches require rehydration. These represent operational targets and are documented in our runbook.
- RPO: ≤15 minutes when configured with 15-minute snapshot cadence. For customers choosing longer snapshot intervals, RPO increases accordingly and is captured in the customer configuration document.

2) Runbook and auditor access
- We provide a read-only runbook summary to auditors on request.
- For operational playbook review or live evidence, customers may grant temporary jumpbox access (time-limited SSO + MFA) under a controlled audit window.
- All access is recorded in our audit logs; enterprise contracts default to 7-year retention of access logs.

3) Restore testing cadence and results
- Weekly partial restores for critical subsystems, quarterly full restores, and a quarterly canary restore in a cold region to validate cross-region failover.
- See restore-test-matrix.xlsx for specific runs; overall success rate 98.6% across the last 12 months. Example: 2026-02-10 full restore: 3h12m total; validation automated checks completed in 18m.

4) KMS and key rotation
- Customer-managed keys supported (AWS/GCP KMS + HSM).
- Recommended rotation cadence: 90 days; support for custom rotation schedules.

If helpful, we can produce control-mapping rows (FFIEC control ID → Redwood artifact + evidence link).
